Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১) Which is not true about staphylococcus?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
The statement “all are coagulase positive” is false. All Staphylococcus species are Gram-positive cocci arranged in grape-like clusters and are catalase positive, but only some species are coagulase positive.

  • Staphylococcus → Gram-positive cocci

  • Arrangement → grape-like clusters

  • Catalase → positive

  • Coagulase → variable

    • S. aureus → coagulase positive

    • S. epidermidis, S. saprophyticus → coagulase negative

High-yield Staphylococcus recall:
S. aureus = Coagulase positive
S. epidermidis & S. saprophyticus = Coagulase negative

Exam pearl:
“All Staph are catalase positive, but not all are coagulase positive.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ২) Which one is the most common bacterial cause of sore throat?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A β-hemolytic Streptococcus) is the most common bacterial cause of acute pharyngitis (sore throat), particularly in children and adolescents.

Most sore throats overall are viral, but among bacterial causes, S. pyogenes is the classic and most important pathogen because untreated infection can lead to complications such as acute rheumatic fever.

High-yield Streptococcus recall:
S. pyogenes → Group A, β-hemolytic → pharyngitis, scarlet fever, rheumatic fever, PSGN

Exam pearl:
“Bacterial sore throat = think Group A Strep (S. pyogenes).”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ৩) Which mosquito transmits dengue virus?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Dengue virus is transmitted primarily by the female Aedes mosquito, especially Aedes aegypti. It is a day-biting mosquito and breeds commonly in artificial water containers.

  • Aedes → Dengue, chikungunya, yellow fever, Zika

  • Anopheles → Malaria

  • Culex → Filariasis, Japanese encephalitis

  • “Loveron” → Not a mosquito genus

High-yield Vector recall:
Aedes aegypti → Dengue
Anopheles → Malaria
Culex → Filariasis/Japanese encephalitis

Exam pearl:
“Dengue = Aedes aegypti; day-biting mosquito.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ৪) What is the route of transmission for VZV?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Varicella-zoster virus (VZV), which causes chickenpox, is transmitted mainly through airborne respiratory droplets/aerosols and direct contact with vesicular fluid. Respiratory transmission is the classic route.

  • Respiratory secretion → major route of VZV transmission

  • Direct contact with vesicular lesions → also important

  • Perinatal transmission → possible, but not the usual route

  • Sexual transmission/transfusion → not typical routes

High-yield VZV recall:
VZV → highly contagious → airborne/respiratory spread + contact with vesicle fluid.

Exam pearl:
“Chickenpox spreads mainly through the air.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ৫) Which organism is responsible for gas gangrene?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Clostridium perfringens is the most common cause of gas gangrene (clostridial myonecrosis). It is an anaerobic, Gram-positive, spore-forming bacillus that produces potent toxins, especially alpha toxin (lecithinase/phospholipase C), causing extensive tissue destruction and hemolysis.

  • C. perfringens → Gas gangrene

  • C. tetani → Tetanus

  • C. botulinum → Botulism

  • C. difficile → Antibiotic-associated diarrhea/pseudomembranous colitis

High-yield Clostridium recall:
C. perfringens → gas gangrene
C. tetani → tetanus
C. botulinum → botulism
C. difficile → pseudomembranous colitis

Exam pearl:
“Gas gangrene = C. perfringens.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ৬) Break bone fever is characteristic of which disease?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
“Break-bone fever” is a classic description of dengue fever, referring to the severe muscle, joint, and bone pain (myalgia and arthralgia) that can occur during the illness.

High-yield Dengue recall:
Dengue → high fever + severe myalgia/arthralgia (“break-bone fever”) + headache + retro-orbital pain.

Exam pearl:
“Break-bone fever = Dengue.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ৭) Which of the following causes infection of prosthetic heart bulb & hip?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Staphylococcus epidermidis is a common cause of prosthetic device-associated infections, including prosthetic heart valves and prosthetic joints (e.g., hip prosthesis). Its major virulence factor is biofilm formation, which allows it to adhere to artificial surfaces and resist host defenses and antibiotics.

  • S. epidermidis → prosthetic devices, IV catheters, prosthetic valves/joints

  • S. aureus → skin/soft-tissue infections, bacteremia, endocarditis, osteomyelitis

  • S. saprophyticus → UTI, especially in young women

  • S. pyogenes → pharyngitis, cellulitis, necrotizing fasciitis

High-yield Staphylococcus recall:
S. epidermidis = coagulase-negative + biofilm producer + prosthetic device infection.

Exam pearl:
“Prosthetic device infection → think S. epidermidis.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ৮) Toxoid vaccine is applicable for the prevention of.....?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
A toxoid vaccine is made from a bacterial exotoxin that has been inactivated so it loses toxicity but retains antigenicity. It induces antibodies against the toxin.

Tetanus toxoid is used for prevention of tetanus by inducing antibodies against tetanospasmin, the neurotoxin produced by Clostridium tetani.

High-yield Vaccine recall:
Tetanus → Tetanus toxoid
Diphtheria → Diphtheria toxoid
Both are classic toxoid vaccines.

Exam pearl:
“Toxoid vaccine → Tetanus and Diphtheria.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ৯) peptostreptococcus can be treated with.....
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Peptostreptococcus is an anaerobic Gram-positive coccus and is generally susceptible to Penicillin G. It is commonly associated with anaerobic infections, particularly abscesses and infections involving mucosal flora.

  • Penicillin G → effective against many Peptostreptococcus species

  • Penicillin V → mainly used for susceptible oral/upper respiratory infections

  • Amoxicillin/Ampicillin → may have activity, but Penicillin G is the classic exam answer

High-yield Anaerobe recall:
Peptostreptococcus → anaerobic Gram-positive cocci → Penicillin G is a classic treatment choice.

Exam pearl:
“Peptostreptococcus → think anaerobic GPC → Penicillin G.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১০) Which recurrent infection is caused by HSV-2?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
HSV-2 (Herpes simplex virus type 2) is classically associated with recurrent genital herpes (herpes genitalis). After primary infection, the virus becomes latent in the sacral dorsal root ganglia and can reactivate periodically, causing recurrent genital lesions.

  • HSV-1 → commonly herpes labialis

  • HSV-2 → commonly herpes genitalis

  • HSV-1 → classically temporal lobe encephalitis

  • HSV-1 → commonly herpetic keratitis

High-yield HSV recall:
HSV-1 → oral/labial lesions, keratitis, encephalitis
HSV-2 → genital herpes, neonatal herpes

Exam pearl:
“HSV-2 = recurrent genital herpes.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১১) Which is not a feature of tetanus?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Tetanus is caused by Clostridium tetani toxin (tetanospasmin), which blocks inhibitory neurotransmission by preventing release of GABA and glycine. This produces generalized muscle rigidity and painful spasms, not flaccid paralysis.

  • Lockjaw (trismus) → classic feature

  • Risus sardonicus → characteristic facial spasm

  • Opisthotonos → severe generalized muscle spasm

  • Flaccid paralysis → not a feature of tetanus

High-yield Tetanus recall:
Tetanus → spastic paralysis due to loss of inhibitory neurotransmission.
Botulism → flaccid paralysis due to impaired acetylcholine release.

Exam pearl:
“Tetanus = rigid/spastic; Botulism = flaccid.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১২) What is the classic lesion caused by S. aureus?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Staphylococcus aureus classically causes abscesses due to its pyogenic (pus-forming) nature. A localized collection of pus surrounded by inflamed tissue is a classic lesion of S. aureus infection.

  • Abscess → classic lesion of S. aureus

  • Folliculitis → commonly caused by S. aureus

  • Impetigo → commonly S. aureus and/or S. pyogenes

  • Scalded skin syndrome → S. aureus exfoliative toxin

High-yield Staphylococcus recall:
S. aureus → abscesses, boils, carbuncles, wound infections
Coagulase positive → S. aureus

Exam pearl:
“S. aureus = pus + abscess.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১৩) What type of spore is produced by C. tetani?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Clostridium tetani produces a characteristic terminal, spherical spore that gives the bacillus a “drumstick” or “tennis racket” appearance. The spore is located at the end of the bacterial cell.

  • C. tetani → terminal spore → drumstick appearance

  • C. perfringens → usually non-sporing in clinical specimens

  • C. botulinum → subterminal spore

  • C. difficile → subterminal spores

High-yield Clostridium recall:
C. tetani → terminal spore → drumstick appearance.

Exam pearl:
“Tetanus = terminal spore = drumstick bacillus.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১৪) What is the usual site of latency for CMV?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Cytomegalovirus (CMV) establishes lifelong latency mainly in monocytes and their myeloid progenitor cells. Reactivation can occur when cellular immunity is impaired, such as in transplant recipients or advanced HIV infection.

  • CMV → monocytes / myeloid lineage cells

  • HSV-1 → trigeminal ganglion

  • HSV-2 → sacral sensory ganglia

  • EBV → B lymphocytes

High-yield Herpesvirus latency recall:
CMV → Monocytes
EBV → B lymphocytes
HSV-1 → Trigeminal ganglion
HSV-2 → Sacral ganglion
VZV → Dorsal root/sensory ganglia

Exam pearl:
“CMV hides in monocytes.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১৫) Which one is known as spreading factor for streptococcus?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Hyaluronidase is called the “spreading factor” because it breaks down hyaluronic acid in the extracellular matrix of connective tissue, facilitating the spread of Streptococcus through tissues.

  • Hyaluronidase → spreading factor

  • Streptokinase → dissolves fibrin clots

  • DNase → breaks down extracellular DNA in pus

  • Streptolysin → causes hemolysis and tissue damage

High-yield Streptococcus virulence factor recall:
Hyaluronidase = spreading factor
Streptokinase = fibrinolysin
Streptolysin O/S = hemolysis
DNase = breaks down DNA

Exam pearl:
“Hyaluronidase helps bacteria spread through tissues.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১৬) Which type of toxin is most important in pathogenesis of gas gangrene?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
The alpha toxin of Clostridium perfringens is the most important toxin in the pathogenesis of gas gangrene (clostridial myonecrosis). It is a lecithinase/phospholipase C that destroys cell membranes, causing myonecrosis, hemolysis, tissue destruction, and edema.

  • Alpha toxin → phospholipase C (lecithinase) → gas gangrene

  • Beta toxin → important in other C. perfringens diseases, especially enteritis

  • Delta toxin → hemolysin

  • Gamma toxin → not the classic toxin responsible for gas gangrene

High-yield Clostridium recall:
C. perfringens → Alpha toxin → phospholipase C → gas gangrene

Exam pearl:
“Gas gangrene = C. perfringens alpha toxin.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১৭) Which staphylococcus species is coagulase positive?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Staphylococcus aureus is the classically coagulase-positive Staphylococcus species. Coagulase converts fibrinogen to fibrin, helping the organism form a protective fibrin clot around itself.

  • S. aureus → Coagulase positive

  • S. epidermidis → Coagulase negative

  • S. saprophyticus → Coagulase negative

  • Not all Staphylococcus species are coagulase positive

High-yield Staphylococcus recall:
S. aureus = Coagulase positive
S. epidermidis + S. saprophyticus = Coagulase negative

Exam pearl:
“Coagulase-positive Staphylococcus = S. aureus.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১৮) Which antiviral is used in dengue?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
There is no specific antiviral treatment routinely available for dengue. Management is mainly supportive, including adequate fluids, monitoring for warning signs, and appropriate fever/pain control.

  • Acyclovir → Herpes simplex, Varicella-zoster

  • Valacyclovir → HSV, VZV

  • Famciclovir → HSV, VZV

  • Dengue → No specific antiviral; supportive treatment

High-yield Dengue recall:
Dengue → supportive management + careful fluid management.
Avoid aspirin and NSAIDs because of the risk of bleeding; paracetamol (acetaminophen) is generally preferred for fever/pain.

Exam pearl:
“Dengue has no specific antiviral therapy—treat supportively.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ১৯) What is predisposing factor for S. saprophyticus?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Staphylococcus saprophyticus is a common cause of community-acquired urinary tract infection (UTI), particularly in young, sexually active women. Sexual activity is therefore an important predisposing factor.

  • S. saprophyticus → UTI in young sexually active women

  • S. epidermidis → IV catheters/prosthetic devices

  • S. aureus → IV drug use can predispose to bacteremia/endocarditis

High-yield Staphylococcus recall:
S. saprophyticus → UTI → young sexually active women → novobiocin resistant.

Exam pearl:
“Young + sexually active + UTI = S. saprophyticus.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ২০) Which one is most important antiphagocytic factor S. pyogenes?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
The M protein is the most important antiphagocytic virulence factor of Streptococcus pyogenes. It is located on the bacterial surface and inhibits opsonization and phagocytosis, particularly by interfering with complement-mediated clearance.

  • M protein → antiphagocytic factor

  • DNase → degrades DNA in pus

  • Hyaluronidase → spreading factor

  • Streptokinase → fibrinolysis/spreading through tissues

High-yield S. pyogenes recall:
M protein → antiphagocytic + major virulence factor
Anti-M antibodies → protective but associated with rheumatic fever through molecular mimicry

Exam pearl:
“S. pyogenes escapes phagocytosis with M protein.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ২১) What kind of noun is the word ‘Girl’?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
“Girl” is a common noun because it refers to a general class of persons rather than a particular individual.

  • Common noun: girl, boy, city, doctor

  • Proper noun: Fahad, Dhaka, Bangladesh

  • Collective noun: team, crowd, committee

  • Material noun: gold, water, iron

High-yield Grammar recall:
A common noun names a person, place, animal, or thing in general.

Exam pearl:
“Girl” = Common noun; “Fahad” = Proper noun.

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ২২) Truth শব্দটির adjective হবে -
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Truth is a noun, and its corresponding adjective is truthful, meaning honest or speaking the truth.

  • Truth → Noun

  • Truthful → Adjective

  • Truly → Adverb

  • Truism → Noun

High-yield Grammar recall:
Truth (N) → Truthful (Adj) → Truly (Adv)

Exam pearl:
“Truthful” = adjective form of “truth.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ২৩) Muslims fast during Ramadan, here ‘fast’ is-
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
In the sentence “Muslims fast during Ramadan,” the word “fast” describes the action performed by the subject (Muslims). Therefore, it functions as a verb meaning “to abstain from food and drink.”

High-yield Grammar recall:
A word's part of speech depends on its use in the sentence. Here, fast = verb.

Exam pearl:
“Muslims fast” → fast = Verb.

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ২৪) Which one is Reflexive Pronoun?
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
Myself is a reflexive pronoun because it refers back to the subject “I” and is used when the subject and object are the same person.

  • He → Personal pronoun

  • Each → Distributive pronoun

  • Myself → Reflexive pronoun

  • Who → Interrogative/relative pronoun

High-yield Grammar recall:
Reflexive pronouns: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.

Exam pearl:
“I → myself; he → himself; they → themselves.”

Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.question: ২৫) He is a better worker than I. Here ‘better’ is-
Dengue, herpeszoster.. + Parts of speech.exp:
In “He is a better worker than I,” the word “better” modifies the noun “worker” by describing the worker's quality. Therefore, better is an adjective.

Here, better is the comparative form of “good.”

  • Good → better → best

  • Better → adjective, modifying worker

High-yield Grammar recall:
Good → better → best
Bad → worse → worst

Exam pearl:
If “better” describes a noun → Adjective; if it modifies a verb → Adverb.
